messages:
Nia (People Ops): Candidate Felix (SWE) is in Singapore and asked for an early SGT slot next week due to timezone. He prefers 09:00 SGT. Can we make that work with panelers in PT/CEST?
Omar (Recruiter): PT panelers can do 17:00 PT which is 09:00 SGT. CEST folks will join remotely later. Riya, ok to start at 09:00 SGT?
Riya (Hiring Manager): Yes. Suggest compact schedule: 09:00-09:35 tech, 09:35-10:10 take-home buffer, 10:10-10:50 system design. Will debrief offline.
Nia (People Ops): Candidate requested a loaner Windows laptop (Docker + Node). Also asked for captions and a low-light camera setting.
ITAssetBot: Reserved 1x Dell XPS (Win11) from APAC pool. Loaner ID: APAC-LOAN-7712. Hold at reception for contactless pickup.
Facilities: Quiet room reserved (APAC Hub R2). Camera will be set to low-light mode on the room device. Live captions enabled on Zoom.
Omar (Recruiter): Quick policy Q: Felix asked about taxi reimbursement if he visits office. Policy: local travel reimbursement up to $100 USD with receipts. I'll include that in candidate note.
Nia (People Ops): Need NDA signed before sending take-home repo. Omar, can you send DocuSign? Also flag Greenhouse stage to "Final Loop Scheduled".
Omar (Recruiter): DocuSign sent. Candidate signed within 40m. Greenhouse updated.
Nia (People Ops): Candidate phone +65 9123 0000 for loaner pickup. Also request: Felix needs an ergonomic keyboard adapter. IT please include.
ITAssetBot: Ergonomic adapter added to loaner box. Return label included. Tracking AP-7712 shipped to hub.
Riya (Hiring Manager): Can you make the private repo expire in 8 hours after access? Also set the take-home language to Node 16.
Omar (Recruiter): Will attach repo with 8h expiry and Node 16 runtime.
Nia (People Ops): Calendar invite draft below 0% copy-paste into event when creating:
```
Title: Redwood Final Loop 0 Felix (SWE)
When: Wed 09:00-10:50 SGT
Where: Zoom (live captions enabled) + APAC Hub R2 (loaner pickup at Reception)
Agenda: 09:00-09:35 Tech (screen share), 09:35-10:10 Break & take-home task, 10:10-10:50 System design, 10:50-11:00 Panel debrief (internal)
Notes: Low-light camera; ergonomic adapter included in loaner (APAC-LOAN-7712). NDA signed; repo link to be sent post-09:35, expires in 8h. Candidate phone +65 9123 0000. Travel reimbursement up to $100 with receipts.
Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/felix-final
```
Riya (Hiring Manager): Looks good. After loop please remind panel to submit Greenhouse scorecards within 24h and include any accessibility notes.
Nia (People Ops): Thanks team 1 wish everyone a smooth loop. :white_check_mark:
